main_text.p: indices servat, atque ex his rationes senamagistri. tui debet. Quid de Trium-viris, vecti-Quesflores reditum galium, portoriorum accisarum, uti vo-Sacerdota-lium. cant, magistris, ad forum & curiam lo-Orphano-tropheij curatores. co idoneo negotio huic & muneri suo va-cantibus? Quid de iis, qui pecuniam Sa-cerdotiis olim legatam, solvendo minis-tris Ecclesiae stipendio, & sartis tectis tenendis eorum domiciliis colligunt, & expendunt? Quid de orphanotropheij curatoribus, & eleemosynariis pauperum domi sedentium alimoniae praepositis? qui omnes ex honestissimis civium ordinibus a senatu leguntur, in tempus incertum, ab ejusque arbitrio pendent. Adde ante hos nominandum honoris causa jurisconsultum, quem S Y N D I-Syndicus. C U M dicunt, liberali Reip. stipendio ornatum, summaque dignitate: qui & a consilio est senatus, & ejusdem orator, adeoque universae civitatis advocatus: quem locum amplissimus & consultissimus, clarissimusque vir, amicus singularis, P A N C R A T I U S C A S T R I-COMIUS I. U.D. jam ab annis aliquot, & nunc; dum haec recuduntur,

page.notes: Running head and marginal notes are read from a low-contrast scan; "Groninga" and "Quesflores" are as far as the print can be made out and are marked or kept as printed. The marginal notes "Sacerdota-" and "Orphano-" are split across lines with printed hyphens; they are joined here as "Sacerdota-lium" and "Orphano-tropheij". The text is set as one paragraph continued from the previous page; no indent is visible within it. The catchword "tenet." is printed at the right below the last line.
